sources.entry: Outline | A modern team knowledge base

summary.one_liner: Outline is the source code for a fast, collaborative team knowledge base built with React and Node.js, which can be self-hosted or used via the hosted getoutline.com service.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes this repository as the source code that runs Outline and its associated services. It states that the hosted version is available at getoutline.com, so running your own copy is optional. Production installation is covered by separate documentation that the README links to rather than explaining inline. The README says Outline logs simple prefixed console output in development and JSON logs in production, with HTTP logging off by default and controllable via DEBUG and LOG_LEVEL environment variables. Tests are written with Vitest, and database migrations are managed with Sequelize. An architecture document is referenced for a high-level overview of the codebase.
use_cases: run a private wiki for a team
customize or extend a React and Node.js knowledge base app
review logging and migration setup for a wiki service
how_to_run: Follow the production installation documentation referenced in the README (not included inline)
For development setup, see the development guide linked in the README
notable: Hosted version available at getoutline.com if you do not want to self-host
Structured JSON logging in production, prefixed console logs in development
Contribution policy requires discussing changes with the core team before submitting pull requests
Explicit ban on AI-generated pull requests in the contributing guidelines
caveats: Installation details are in external documentation, not the README itself
Licensed under BSL 1.1, which is source-available rather than OSI open source
Pull requests must be discussed with the core team first; unsolicited AI-generated PRs are not accepted
